jobs.title: Brand Manager
jobs.description:
**About the company**

A fast-growing international FMCG organisation with operations in the UK, Europe, and Middle East specialising in the development, marketing, and distribution of premium haircare and beauty brands. With an expanding portfolio of owned brands and a strong presence across retail, ecommerce, and professional channels, we are committed to delivering high-performance products that inspire confidence and elevate everyday beauty routines.

**Role Purpose**

The Brand Manager will lead the brand as a commercially accountable business unit, with full responsibility for revenue, gross margin, marketing investment and brand contribution. The role will develop and execute the commercial and brand strategy, strengthen consumer relevance, expand profitable distribution and deliver sustainable market-share growth. The postholder will work cross-functionally with Sales, E-commerce, Supply Chain, Finance, Product Development and external partners to convert brand plans into measurable commercial results.

**Key Responsibilities**

· **P&L ownership:** Own the annual budget, rolling forecast and monthly performance of the brand, including net sales, gross margin, promotional spend, marketing investment, operating costs and brand contribution.

· **Brand strategy:** Develop the annual brand plan, defining target consumers, positioning, portfolio priorities, channel strategy, pricing architecture and growth initiatives.

· **Commercial delivery:** Partner with Sales and E-commerce to set channel and customer targets, improve distribution, increase rate of sale and deliver profitable promotional plans.

· **Customer and channel development:** Strengthen existing customer relationships, identify new accounts and routes to market, and support negotiations, range reviews and commercial proposals.

· **Market and business insight:** Monitor category trends, competitor activity, pricing, customer performance and commercial data; translate insights into clear actions.

· **Pricing, margin and promotion:** Recommend pricing, promotional activity, trade investment and commercial terms; monitor product and customer profitability and improve return on investment.

· **Marketing and activation:** Work with marketing department to ensure campaigns across digital. Social media, influencer, retails, trade and events support agreed commercial objectives and deliver measurable returns.

· **Portfolio management:** Lead commercial into product lifecycle decisions, new product development, launches, renovations, pricing and discontinuations; maintain a commercially productive SKU portfolio.

· **Forecasting and stock:** Work with Demand Planning and Supply Chain to improve forecast accuracy, maintain availability, manage inventory health and minimise aged or obsolete stock.

· **Customer and partner management:** Create compelling customer presentations and toolkits, support key account meetings and manage agencies and suppliers against agreed deliverables.

· **Governance:** Lead monthly commercial performance reviews, identify risks and opportunities, and implement corrective actions with clear owners and deadlines.

**Experience and Qualifications**

· Proven brand management experience in beauty, haircare, cosmetics, hair extensions, FMCG or a related consumer category.

· Demonstrable ownership of a brand P&L, budget and forecast, with a strong understanding of gross margin and commercial drivers.

· Track record of delivering commercial growth through retail, wholesale, professional, e-commerce or marketplace channels.

· Experience developing brand plans, managing integrated campaigns and measuring marketing effectiveness.

· Strong analytical skills, including interpretation of sales, margin, consumer, customer and inventory data.

· Experience of new product development, launches, portfolio rationalisation and agency management.

· Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Business, Commercial Management or a related discipline; relevant postgraduate or professional qualification is desirable.

**Core Competencies**

· Commercial and financial acumen

· Strategic brand thinking with strong execution discipline

· Consumer and customer orientation

· Data-led decision-making and problem-solving

· Ownership, pace and accountability

· Clear communication and presentation skills

Pay: £55,000.00-£60,000.00 per year

Ability to commute/relocate:

* North West London, Greater London: reliably commute or plan to relocate before starting work (preferred)

Application question(s):

* Do you have experience in Beauty and cosmetics/hair extensions?

Experience:

* FMCG: 5 years (preferred)

Work Location: In person

A collective energy and ambition. A place where you can make a real difference.
  
  
We’re a company that genuinely cares about our people, our products, our consumers and the environment.
  
  
Our unique, informal culture champions courage, determination and collaboration. Knowing we have an open and supportive team means each of us has the freedom to take responsibility and ownership. We have a shared passion to work hard, innovate and push boundaries.
  
  
United by the belief that when we strive for growth, anything is possible. While we might not be the largest company in our industry, we believe we can have the biggest impact because: Together We Have the Power to Win.
  
  
**Are you passionate about building iconic consumer brands?**
**Do you combine creative marketing thinking with strong commercial awareness?**
**Would you like to play a central role in driving the continued growth of Batiste?**
If so, we have an exciting opportunity for a
**Brand Manager**
to join our
**Marketing team**
and help shape the future of
**Batiste**
, the world’s leading dry shampoo brand.

Working across brand campaigns, innovation, retailer opportunities and integrated marketing channels, you will partner closely with Sales, Category, Digital, Product Development, Supply Chain and agency partners to deliver activity that strengthens the brand and drives commercial results.
  
  
This role is based in our London Office and allows for home working up to 3 days per week.

* Develop and deliver annual brand plans aligned with Batiste’s strategic and commercial objectives.
* Protect and strengthen the Batiste brand identity across packaging, digital, social media, retail and in-store activation.
* Analyse sales performance, consumer trends and competitor activity using platforms such as Circana and Kantar.
* Support the development and commercialisation of innovation, renovation, retailer opportunities and portfolio initiatives, working closely with International and cross-functional teams.
* Partner closely with Sales, Category and e-Commerce teams to develop effective customer plans and translate brand priorities into strong in-market execution.
* Plan and deliver integrated campaigns across digital, social media, PR, retail, in-store and direct-to-consumer channels.
* Develop compelling content that increase brand awareness, encourage trial and support repeat purchase.
* Manage relationships with creative, media. Social and PR agencies to ensure high-quality and consistent execution.
* Evaluate campaign, launch and channel performance to continuously improve marketing effectiveness and return on investment.
* Work closely with Supply Chain, Operations, Product Development and other functions to ensure strong end-to-end project delivery.
* Manage the brand marketing budget, track performance against KPIs and ensure a strong return on investment.
* Contribute to a positive, creative and energetic team environment.

**Education & Experience**

* A degree in Marketing, Business, Communications or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Proven experience within brand management, consumer marketing or a related marketing role.
* Experience leading integrated marketing activity and product launches from planning to execution and evaluation.
* Experience working within FMCG, beauty, personal care or another fast-moving consumer environment would be beneficial.
* Experience managing creative, media, social, PR or other external agency partners.
* Familiarity with brand tracking, campaign measurement and post-campaign evaluation.

We’re looking for an ambitious, commercially minded marketer and consumer-centric who combines strong brand thinking with creativity, curiosity and a bias for action. You’ll be confident using consumer, sales and market insights to identify opportunities and turn them into clear, actionable plans, with strong organisational and project management skills to take activity from idea through to execution.
  
  
You’ll be an excellent communicator who can build effective relationships across cross functional teams and external agency partners, while bringing a keen eye for detail and a strong understanding of consumer behaviour and market trends. Comfortable balancing brand-building activity with commercial objectives, you’ll thrive in a fast-paced FMCG environment and be excited by the opportunity to help shape the continued growth and success of Batiste.
  
  
This role works Monday – Friday, 37-hours per week.

**We’ve signed up to an ambitious journey. Join us!**
*As Arrive, we guide customers and communities towards brighter futures and more livable cities, it isn’t a challenge just anyone could take on. Luckily, we have something to help us make it happen. As the Digital Growth & Content Lead, you will own the end-to-end digital ecosystem for the Automotive & Data (A&D) business unit. As a highly autonomous individual contributor, you will act as a strategic doer - responsible for both setting the digital and content agenda and hands-on executing it, ensuring our technical innovations translate into market-leading authority and measurable commercial impact. Your mission is to drive the "why" behind our digital presence, shaping brand narrative while optimising our channels and content to drive pipeline and audience scale.
  
  
In this role, you will define and execute a sophisticated content and digital strategy that positions Arrive as the essential platform for in-car payments and a leader in connected services. You will balance long-term brand building with short-term commercial objectives, owning the strategy for lead generation contribution, SEO, and multi-channel engagement. By leveraging data-driven insights and cross-functional leadership, you will scale our digital footprint and build a narrative that consistently generates demand, engagement and high-authority market positioning.

**Digital Channel Strategy & Growth**

* Ecosystem Ownership: Lead the strategic development and implementation of the A&D digital ecosystem, including website, CRM, and social channels to maximise reach and conversion.
* Growth Optimisation: Drive direct growth strategies across LinkedIn and other professional channels, leveraging content to expand our influence within the automotive sector.
* Subscriber Acquisition: Shape and execute global newsletters and database growth strategies, focusing on high-value lead acquisition and retention.
* Innovation: Identify and implement emerging digital marketing technologies and AI-driven workflows to increase operational efficiency and content performance.

**Content Strategy & Brand Authority**

* Strategic Narrative: Own the content roadmap, ensuring all messaging aligns with Arrive’s global brand vision while specifically addressing A&D’s products and complex technical audience.
* Authority Building: Hands-on creation and production of high-impact newsletters, media, whitepapers, case studies, and thought-leadership pieces.
* Brand Guardianship: Govern and apply the visual and verbal identity of the business unit, ensuring absolute consistency across all external media, video, and event assets you create and manage.

**Performance & Commercial Impact**

* Pipeline Generation & Expansion: Optimise the lead-to-opportunity funnel, ensuring digital activities contribute directly to both net-new qualified inbound sales pipeline and cross-sell/upsell opportunities within existing accounts.
* Customer Retention & Affinity: Own digital lifecycle initiatives aimed at existing customers, utilising targeted content and channel strategies to keep them highly engaged, maximise lifetime value, and build lasting brand loyalty.
* Analytics & ROI: Own the reporting suite for digital performance, translating complex metrics into actionable insights for the Senior Leadership Team.

**Skills & Requirements**

* Proven experience leading digital growth and executing content strategy and creation within the B2B tech, automotive, or SaaS sectors.
* Proven track record of managing and optimising full-stack marketing ecosystems (HubSpot or Salesforce CRM/CMS proficiency is essential).
* Expertise in SEO, data analytics, and performance marketing, with the ability to link digital activity to commercial revenue.
* Strong leadership skills with experience managing external agencies, vendors and cross-functional internal stakeholders.
* Strategic thinker capable of balancing brand-led authority with commercial growth targets.

Arrive, including brands like EasyPark, Flowbird, RingGo, ParkMobile and Parkopedia, is a leading global mobility platform. Present in over 90 countries and 20,000 cities, the company helps people and decision-makers make smarter decisions about urban mobility and ease the experience of travel worldwide. Arrive delivers a unique combination of the core ingredients to make cities more livable: from smart payments and optimized car parks to data-driven traffic reduction and support for reinvestment in public transport and green space. It’s about more than function, it’s about saving time and simplifying the experience of travel for everyone. Travel is more than a journey, it’s how you Arrive.

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
**The Role**

We’re looking for an experienced, strategic Senior Digital Marketing Manager to lead the growth of the Smiley ecosystem online. This role sits at the intersection of global lifestyle branding, e-commerce, and purpose-driven storytelling, and you’ll own the digital strategy that brings them together.

You’ll set the direction for our digital channels across Smiley® & SmileyWorld® Shopify e-commerce platform and the Smiley Movement editorial platform, leading a small in-house team alongside agencies and specialist consultants to make sure our content reaches and resonates with millions of people around the world.

You’ll own the strategy, budget, and results across content, SEO, performance marketing, and emerging AI tools, deciding how we experiment, optimise, and scale the way our message is delivered across multiple platforms.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Digital Strategy & Leadership**

* Develop and own the digital marketing strategy and annual plan across Smiley, SmileyWorld, and Smiley Movement, aligned with commercial and brand objectives.
* Own the digital marketing budget, allocating spend across channels, agencies, consultants, and tools to maximise return.
* Set KPIs and targets for traffic, conversion, revenue, engagement, and audience growth, and report performance to senior leadership.
* Partner with design and content teams to align digital activity with launches, campaigns, and brand moments.

**Agency & Consultant Management**

* Lead the management of agencies and consultants across paid media, SEO, GEO, web development, content, and creative production.
* Write clear briefs, agree scopes of work, deliverables, and fees, and manage contracts and SOWs within budget.
* Hold partners accountable through regular status meetings, performance reviews, and agreed KPIs and SLAs.
* Review and approve agency and consultant work for quality, brand consistency, and commercial impact before it goes live.
* Manage agency and consultant budgets, track spend against plan, and approve invoices.
* Regularly review the partner roster, identifying when to bring capabilities in-house, consolidate suppliers, or source new specialist support.

**E-commerce & Content**

* Own the performance of the Smiley® and SmileyWorld® Shopify store, driving traffic, conversion rate, and average order value through merchandising, CRO testing, and UX improvements.
* Oversee the Smiley Movement editorial platform on Craft CMS, ensuring content is optimised for reach.
* Manage the website calendar across brands, product launches, and campaigns.

**SEO & Digital Optimisation**

* Own the organic search strategy across e-commerce and editorial properties, working with SEO agency partners where relevant.
* Oversee technical, on-page, and content SEO, including site health, metadata, headings, internal linking, structured data, and image alt text.
* Track rankings, traffic, and engagement, and turn insights into a prioritised optimisation roadmap.

**AI & Marketing Innovation**

* Lead the adoption of AI tools across marketing workflows, defining where they add value and setting guidelines for responsible, on-brand use.
* Drive testing of AI-driven approaches to content creation, translation, personalisation, and SEO/GEO optimisation.
* Identify where automation and AI can improve efficiency and scale content production, and build the business case to implement them.

**Paid Social & Performance Marketing**

* Own the paid social strategy across TikTok, Meta (Instagram & Facebook), and YouTube, from planning and budgeting through to creative direction and optimisation.
* Own measurement and attribution, making sure tracking, pixels, and analytics are set up correctly so decisions are based on reliable data.
* Stay on top of platform trends and cultural moments so campaigns feel native and relevant.

**Who You Are**

**A Strategic Leader**

You can set a clear digital vision, turn it into a practical plan, and bring people with you, both in-house and across external partners.

**A Confident Partner Manager**

You know how to get the best out of agencies and consultants. You brief well, push for quality, negotiate fairly, and aren’t afraid to have honest conversations when work falls short.

**A Strong Communicator**

You can adapt your writing style to the audience, from commercial product messaging for Smiley brands to purpose-driven storytelling for Smiley Movement, and you’re comfortable presenting to senior stakeholders.

**Commercial & Data-Driven**

You’re comfortable owning targets and budgets, and you use data on traffic, conversion, and ROI to make decisions and explain them clearly.

**AI-Forward**

You’ve used tools like Claude or Midjourney in your own work and have a point of view on how AI will reshape marketing teams and workflows.

**Requirements**

* 5+ years of experience in digital marketing, with at least 2 years in a management or lead role
* Proven experience managing agencies and consultants, including briefing, scoping, budget control, and performance management
* A track record of growing a D2C e-commerce brand, ideally on Shopify
* Strong knowledge of SEO, including technical and content SEO
* Hands-on experience with paid social platforms such as Meta Ads Manager and TikTok Ads Manager, and managing paid media budgets
* Confident with analytics tools such as GA4, Plausable, Sprinklr and Shopify Analytics
* Experience managing and developing direct reports
* Ability to manage multiple brands, budgets, partners, and publishing schedules at once
* Experience in lifestyle, fashion, licensing, or consumer brands is a plus

**What's on offer?**

* Competitive base Salary
* 33 days holiday (including bank holidays)
* Pension scheme
* WFH Fridays
* Access to Perkbox and Vitality health insurance
* Summer & Christmas events
* Reduced summer hours

jobs.title: Event Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**
Since 1843, The Economist Group has championed independence, excellence and openness, helping people understand and tackle the critical challenges shaping the world. Today, we are building on that legacy as a global media and information-services company powered by digital innovation, analytical rigour and evidence-based insight.
  
  
Across our three businesses -
*The Economist, Economist Enterprise and Economist Education*
- we deliver trusted analysis and insights to individuals and organisations in more than 170 countries. United by a shared purpose to drive progress, we empower decision-makers to make sense of change and chart a course through an increasingly complex world.
  
  
As a colleague, you will be part of a culture that values ideas, encourages ownership and holds itself to high standards. We invest in people who are curious, thoughtful and adaptable, whether they are launching new products, reporting on global events or harnessing emerging technologies such as AI to improve how we work. Here, fresh thinking is taken seriously, ambition is matched by integrity, and great work is recognised. Working across disciplines, geographies and perspectives, we are united by a commitment to innovation, excellence and creating meaningful impact.
  
  
Want to discover more about life at The Economist Group? Follow @EconomistCareers on Instagram to discover the people, stories and opportunities that make TEG unique.
  
  
The Economist Group is a leading source of analysis on international business and world affairs. We deliver our information through a range of formats, from newspapers and magazines to conferences and digital services. What ties us together is the objectivity of our opinion, the originality of our insight and our advocacy of economic and political freedom around the world.
  
  
EuroFinance, an Economist Group business, is a leading global provider of conferences, training and research on cash management, treasury and risk. We bring together treasurers and CFOs from the world’s leading companies to exchange strategies, best practice and expert opinion.
  
  
We are looking for a Marketing Manager to lead attendee marketing for a portfolio of EuroFinance events. You will create and deliver campaigns that grow corporate attendance and ticket revenue, reach new audiences and keep our community engaged. You will work closely with sales, content and event teams, using campaign data to improve performance throughout the event cycle.
  
  
**How will you contribute?**

* Marketing strategy – Develop and present marketing plans for approximately three events annually, with clear audience, registration and revenue goals.
* Campaign execution – Manage integrated campaigns across email, websites, social media, digital advertising, partnerships and direct invitations.
* Audience growth – Build targeted campaigns that attract new corporate treasurers while encouraging past attendees to return.
* Content and copywriting – Turn agenda themes, speakers and research into compelling copy for emails, landing pages, brochures and sales materials.
* Campaign management – Own campaign schedules, creative briefs and budgets, coordinating with designers, suppliers and internal teams to deliver work on time.
* Sales collaboration – Work with sponsorship and delegate sales teams to support their campaigns and communicate the value of EuroFinance’s audience.
* Reporting and optimisation – Track registrations, revenue, conversion and channel performance, using insights to refine campaigns and report against event KPIs.

**The Ideal Skills For This Role Are**

* Proven experience marketing B2B conferences or other complex B2B products.
* Strong campaign planning and project management skills, with the ability to manage several priorities at once.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to write clear, persuasive marketing copy.
* Experience with email marketing, audience segmentation and marketing automation platforms. SalesForce Marketing Cloud, NEXT preferrable
* A good understanding of digital channels, including paid search, paid social, SEO and website optimisation.
* Confidence using CRM data, analytics and spreadsheets to assess performance and make recommendations.
* Experience working with a website CMS and briefing creative assets.
* A commercial mindset and the ability to collaborate effectively with sales, content and event teams.
* An interest in financial services, treasury or business events. Previous experience in these areas is a plus.

**Working Arrangements**
The majority of our roles operate on a hybrid working pattern, with 3+ days office attendance required.
  
  
**AI usage for your application**
We are an innovative organisation that encourages the use of technology. We recognise that candidates may utilise AI tools to support with their job application process. However, it is essential that all information you provide truthfully and accurately reflects your own experience, skills, and qualifications.
  
  
**What We Offer**
Our benefits package is designed to support your wellbeing, growth, and work-life balance. It includes a highly competitive pension or 401(k) plan, private health insurance, and 24/7 access to counselling and wellbeing resources through our Employee Assistance Program.
  
  
We also offer a range of lifestyle benefits, including our
*Work From Anywhere*
program, which allows you to work from any location where you have the legal right to do so for up to 25 days per year. In addition, we provide generous annual and parental leave, as well as dedicated days off for volunteering and even for moving home.
  
  
You will also be given free access to all
*The Economist*
content, including an online subscription, our range of apps, podcasts and more.

As Senior Manager, Marketing Science, you’ll lead measurement for Journey Further’s clients and help them make smarter calls on where their money goes. You’ll be the expert they turn to on what’s working, taking complex models and experiments like MMM, incrementality testing and attribution, and turning them into clear recommendations they can act on.

It’s a role for someone who won’t settle for “the dashboard says so”. You’ll question assumptions, prove what’s driving growth, and help clients get more from every pound they spend on media.

### **What you will do**

* You’ll be the person they call when they want to know what’s really working, and you’ll shape a measurement strategy built around their business, not a template.
* Design and run incrementality tests, from geo tests to holdouts and lift studies, that separate the activity creating new demand from the activity taking credit for sales that would have happened anyway.
* Interpret MMM, MTA and experiment outputs, question the assumptions behind them and turn them into calls clients can act on.
* Bring platform data, experiments and MMM together into one measurement framework, so clients can see exactly how media links to revenue and profit.
* Build forecasts, run “what if” scenarios and tell clients where to move budget next to grow faster.
* Use statistical and causal inference methods to separate the impact of media, creative and targeting from pricing, distribution, competition and seasonality.
* Dig into media data with SQL, R or Python and find the story the numbers are telling.
* Turn complex analysis into clear, confident presentations that change what marketing leaders do, and hold your ground in the room.
* Work side by side with our paid, search and social teams to plan tests, read results and change how budget gets spent.
* Help shape our proprietary measurement tools and IP, and keep us ahead as measurement keeps changing.
* Line manage a small team of analysts, set priorities, give honest feedback and coach them to present insight with confidence.

  
**Requirements**  

* Significant experience in marketing analytics, media effectiveness or analytics consulting, ideally agency-side.
* Deep, hands on experience with MMM, MTA, forecasting and propensity models. You know the assumptions behind them, and you know when to push back on what they’re telling you.
* You’ve designed and analysed experiments yourself, and you’re comfortable with causal inference methods like difference-in-differences or synthetic control.
* Strong SQL, plus R or Python. You’d rather get into the data yourself than wait for someone else to pull it.
* You can explain complex stats to people who don’t speak stats, in a way that changes what they do next.
* You’re confident in front of senior marketing leaders, and you’ll hold your ground when the data says something they don’t want to hear.
* You’ve line managed analysts and enjoy helping people grow.
* You think commercially. You can connect media performance to revenue, margin and the wider business.
* Experience building measurement tools, products or IP.

* Experience with cloud data warehouses like BigQuery.
* Experience juggling multiple clients across different sectors.

Prime Video Live Sports is looking for a Senior Content Manager to manage the lifecycle of our live sports media assets in Europe (EU) and the Rest of the World (ROW). Content comes from many places, such as live match footage, multi-camera iso-feeds, highlights, all with associated metadata, and is stored within Iconik, our media asset management (MAM) platform. We also manage production content for live shows, such as breaks and bumpers, ensuring our vendors are able to access these assets to make their broadcasts.  
  
Live sports generates huge volumes of content on tight turnarounds, so you'll need to balance speed with the long-term discipline of building an archive that's accurate, searchable, user right management, and rights-compliant for years to come.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Manage ingest, cataloging, and metadata tagging of live sports assets in Iconik, including game/match data, teams, players, camera angles, and time-code
